name: Lantern Mosque
summary: A mosque-shaped opening glows within a bold angular lantern, bringing prayer and guidance into one silhouette.
why: A flat base and six-sided body establish a lantern without a bell shape. The large cutout contains a dome, hall, doorway, and minaret. A broad gold handle adds warmth while the negative space keeps the mosque visible in monochrome.
risk: The outer lantern reads first at the smallest sizes; the mosque rewards a closer look. The enclosed composition feels more like an emblem than a freestanding building.
sub1: Prayer as a point of guidance
reasonToChoose: You want an emblem that brings a mosque and a guiding light together.
